entities.name: Esophageal atresia with TEF
observations: Neonatal polyhydramnios, excessive oral secretions, respiratory distress, abdominal distension, and a nasogastric tube coiled in the esophagus are characteristic of esophageal atresia with tracheoesophageal fistula.
Evaluate for associated congenital anomalies, including cardiac defects, after diagnosis of esophageal atresia/tracheoesophageal fistula.
